original_nbrc903_proposal.description: NBRC 903 separately prepared vitamin stock. Vitamin B12 0.1 mg, pABA5 mg and lipoic acid5 mg per 1 L water; generic Ca-pantothenate is preserved. The same literal recipe is used by JCM 197 trace vitamins, but a D-specific ATCC calcium-pantothenate formulation and the current Wolfe stock with KH2PO4 are not established identical.
